incidents.title: The board rendered blank (no widgets, no stats)

updates.text: Reported: the app loaded to an empty board — the bottom buttons appeared, but no widgets, stats bar, or dock pills. Desktop and web both affected for roughly half an hour.

Cause found: a performance change earlier today added what looked like a safe guard, but it ran during app start-up in a way JavaScript forbids — the app's start-up script stopped dead partway through, before the board could build.

Fixed and verified live: the guard now uses a form that can't fail during start-up, a loud comment marks the trap so it can't be re-introduced, and the same pattern was checked everywhere else in the app (all other uses were already safe). If your screen is still blank, force-close and reopen — the fixed version loads automatically.

incidents.title: Web app stuck on “Unlock my cache”

updates.text: Reported: reloading the web app showed “Welcome back”, but “Unlock my cache” always failed with “Something went wrong while processing your request.” — and there was no way to type your encryption key.

Cause found: a recent change asked the cloud to sort your vault by a date field that the vault records don't actually carry. The cloud rejected the whole request, so the app could never read your vault — on the web app, and quietly on the desktop's cloud sync too.

Fixed: vault lookups now sort by a field that always exists, so they can't be rejected. The unlock screen also never dead-ends again — if anything goes wrong, it shows your passphrase box and a sign-in form instead of a button that can't work.

incidents.title: Cloud backups failed with “Failed to create record”

updates.text: Reports of cloud backup failing even while Settings showed “logged in”.
Cause found: cloud logins quietly expire after ~14 days, but the app kept showing the old session as alive — so syncs silently failed with a cryptic error.
Fixed: every backup, restore, and cloud-panel open now refreshes the session first. Regular use never logs you out, and a truly dead session now says plainly “your login expired — log in again.”
